datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a regular monthly schedule throughout 2015, classifying geographic areas by acute food insecurity phase. The spatial data was compiled into GeoJSON and KML formats representing different IPC scenarios and classification scales for Somalia.
